# Rufus Vane

## Overview

- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v4 c6 P29](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0029), [v4 c11 P24](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0024)</sub>
- **Status:** Deceased  <sub>[v4 c31 P28](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0028), [v4 c32 P6](../source/v04-c32.md#nw-v04-c32-p0006)</sub>
- **Role:** Store clerk and summer sailor  <sub>[v4 c11 P24](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0024)</sub>

## Appearance

In his youth, Rufus was a large, good-looking man with a slim build. He had a higher cheek color and slightly paler hair than his double cousin Laurence Vane. He also shared the distinctive Vane family characteristic of having one blue eye and one hazel eye.

_Sources: [v4 c11 P24](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0024), [v4 c13 P15](../source/v04-c13.md#nw-v04-c13-p0015), [v4 c32 P12](../source/v04-c32.md#nw-v04-c32-p0012)_

## Personality

Rufus was a bully from birth who possessed a small, wicked soul. He continuously pursued anything he wanted until he obtained it, at which point he ceased to care for it. Though generally pleasant when everything went smoothly, he was a heavy drinker and engaged in unpleasant behavior.

_Sources: [v4 c11 P4](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0004), [v4 c11 P24](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0024), [v4 c30 P44](../source/v04-c30.md#nw-v04-c30-p0044)_

## History

Rufus Vane spent his summers sailing and his winters clerking in his father Abner's store at the Glen. Becoming obsessed with Lorna Ainslie despite her constant rejections, he forced her into marriage at seventeen by threatening that his father would foreclose on her mother Rose's farm mortgage. Following their wedding, Rufus and Lorna lived on the Ainslie farm through the winter. By spring, after Rose passed away, Rufus grew tired of domestic life and left for Nova Scotia and Cuba. He contracted yellow fever in Cuba and died there thirteen years prior to the events at Seven Gulls. For twelve years, his local community mistakenly believed his surviving double cousin, Laurence Vane—who had suffered severe brain trauma and loss of memory—was Rufus returned home.

_Sources: [v4 c11 P24](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0024), [v4 c11 P26](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0026), [v4 c11 P27](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0027), [v4 c11 P28](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0028), [v4 c21 P46](../source/v04-c21.md#nw-v04-c21-p0046), [v4 c31 P28](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0028), [v4 c32 P6](../source/v04-c32.md#nw-v04-c32-p0006), [v4 c32 P12](../source/v04-c32.md#nw-v04-c32-p0012)_
